name: miff-backend
description: Miff - tests des règles de sécurité Firestore (émulateur uniquement)

scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-miff-rules "npm run test:rules"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-miff-functions "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
